name: Obvious Phishing Email
subject: URGENT ACTION REQUIRED - Account suspended
body:
Dear User,

FINAL WARNING!!! Your account will be suspended within 2 hours. Click here and verify immediately with your password, OTP, PIN, card number and CVV. Open the attachment and keep this secret. Disable antivirus if a warning appears. Claim your prize after verification!!!!

Portal Security Team
explanation: This harmless example combines urgency, credential and financial-data requests, a mismatched IP-based HTTP link, a suspicious download path, and a deceptive executable attachment filename.
